meta_title: ZimaBoard 2 NAS Case with Dual 3.5-Inch HDD Bays
td: A minimal BALMUDA-style ZimaBoard 2 NAS case with dual 3.5-inch HDD bays, printed panels, and a quiet airflow path for a home server build.
summary: This minimal BALMUDA-style enclosure holds a ZimaBoard 2 with two 3.5-inch drives, keeps cabling internal, and leaves the front panel clean.
